The Group:

Technology drives our business. Our team is made up of talented software engineers, infrastructure engineers, data scientists, product leaders, and UX professionals. We care deeply about technology as a craft and a competitive differentiator.

The Central Technology AI team sits at the heart of Morningstar’s technology organization, partnering across the firm to enable responsible, scalable, and innovative uses of artificial intelligence. We build and support AI-powered tools, platforms, and solutions that enhance how Morningstar teams work with data, insights, and products.

The Morningstar Development Program (MDP) is a full-time opportunity designed to launch high-potential early career technologists into impactful, long-term careers at Morningstar. Participants gain hands-on experience through meaningful projects, mentorship from experienced leaders, and exposure to Morningstar’s products, data, and technology ecosystem.

The Role:

The Morningstar Development Program – Central Technology AI is accepting applicants graduating in 2026. Successful candidates will join the Central Technology AI team and be given meaningful, hands-on work aligned to their technical background and interests.

MDP associates are expected to take ownership of their work, collaborate across teams, and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical partners. You will receive structured mentorship, regular feedback, and professional development opportunities throughout the program.

All positions are based in our Chicago office, working 4 days a week.

Responsibilities

Contribute as a member of an Agile technology team, helping to solve business problems through research, analysis, and hands-on development.
Design, build, and enhance AI-enabled solutions, leveraging modern AI tools, frameworks, and programming languages such as Python.
Collaborate with engineers, data scientists, and business partners to translate ideas and requirements into practical, scalable solutions.
Participate in individual and team-based projects, presenting findings and outcomes to stakeholders and senior leaders.
Engage in training and development sessions across Morningstar to build a strong foundation for a long-term career in technology and AI.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience using AI tools, platforms, or frameworks (e.g., generative AI tools, machine learning libraries, or AI-assisted development workflows).
Strong coding skills: experience with additional languages or data tools is a plus.
Demonstrated ability to work independently as a self-starter, taking initiative and ownership of projects.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to diverse audiences.
Strong critical thinking and creative problem-solving abilities.
Ability to adapt quickly and thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Requirements

Currently enrolled in and graduating by June 2026 or have completed degree program, preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.
A resume is required to apply.
Please be sure to include the word “Resume” in the file name of your resume.

The start date for this role is January 11, 2027. 

The base salary for this role is $92,143.

This role will be posted until November 9, 2026.

Morningstar's hybrid work environment gives you the opportunity to collaborate in-person each week as we've found that we're at our best when we're purposely together on a regular basis. In most of our locations, our hybrid work model is four days in-office each week. A range of other benefits are also available to enhance flexibility as needs change. No matter where you are, you'll have tools and resources to engage meaningfully with your global colleagues.

About Us

How to Apply for a Job at Morningstar

Step 1

When you find a position you're interested in, click the 'Apply' button. Please fill out this form completely, attaching your resume and cover letter in the approved format.  Read the job requirements carefully and make sure to attach writing or design samples as required. Applicants must submit their resume and other information through our corporate website to be considered for a job at Morningstar. No phone calls, please.

Step 2

You will receive an email notification to confirm that we've received your application.

Step 3

If you are called in for an interview, a representative from Morningstar will contact you to set up a date, time, and location. Be prepared for a rigorous interview process. To make sure you're a good fit for Morningstar and we're a good fit for you, we'll schedule time for you to meet with multiple staff members at all levels of the company. Expect to return for multiple interviews as part of the process. A representative from Morningstar will contact you with the results of your interview—either with a job offer or to let you know our plans for the position.

Applicants With Disabilities Who Need Accommodation

Morningstar is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please call +1 312 384-3900 or email AskHR@morningstar.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

Please note:

We only accept calls from applicants who need accommodation related to a disability. Please, no calls with unrelated questions or requests.
Please be sure to include the title and location of the open position you’re interested in when you leave a message.
